label: Were 10 chair rises completed? - Myofit sub-study
meta_rows: Were 10 chair rises completed? - Myofit sub-study

Chair rises done in the Myofit sub-study. For those participants who were unable to do the test during the 2023 Home visit, they were asked to do the test during the Myofit clinic visit. These need to be merged with the 2023 HV and NOT the 2015 HV.
linked_rows: Were 10 chair rises completed? - at age 77 years
cat_rows: Study participants were asked by the attending nurse whether they would be willing to be timed performing 10 chair rises.  If willing and able (reasons for inability included health reasons and equipment not available) one test of 10 chair rises was performed. Participants who were unable to do the test during the 2023 Home visit were asked to when they took part in the Myofit (2020-2024) sub-study.
